type Greeter = ((this: { name: string }, greeting: string) => string) | ((this: { id: number }, greeting: string) => string);
const greet: Greeter = function (greeting) {
  return `${greeting}, ${this.name}`;
};
console.log(greet.call({ name: 'Ada', id: 1 }, 'Hello'));

const overloaded: { (this: { x: number }): number; (this: { y: number }, scale?: number): number } = function () {
  return 'x' in this ? this.x : this.y;
};
console.log(overloaded.call({ y: 4 }, 2));

const counter: { count: number; increment(this: { count: number }, by: number): void } = {
  count: 0,
  increment(by) {
    this.count += by;
  },
};
counter.increment(5);
console.log(counter.count);

const identity: (<T>(value: T) => T) | (<U>(value: U) => U) = (value) => value;
console.log(identity('same'), identity(42));

const twice: { <T>(value: T): T[]; <U>(value: U, times?: number): U[] } = (value, times: number = 2) =>
  Array.from({ length: times }, () => value);
console.log(twice('a'), twice(true, 3));

const constrained: (<T extends string>(value: T) => number) | (<U extends string>(value: U) => number) = (value) =>
  value.length;
console.log(constrained('four'));
